title: Add SQL VACUUM manual compaction trigger
description: Expose FusionStorage manual compaction through SQL VACUUM and document the production operations capability.

criteria: VACUUM routes through the normal SQL statement execution path.
FusionStorage VACUUM calls compact_now and preserves table rows after compaction.
Non-Fusion backends and unsupported VACUUM forms return clear errors.
Roadmap and README no longer list SQL manual compaction as missing.

notes: VACUUM is a full-database maintenance operation in this iteration; table-specific VACUUM remains explicit unsupported behavior.
VACUUM FULL is accepted and maps to the same FusionStorage compaction primitive.
Superuser authorization is enforced through authorize_statement for non-legacy users.
